data.name: Manual_Content
data.value:
1. Power on the light and turn on your phone's Bluetooth.
2. Tap “+” on the home page to search for nearby devices, or scan a device share QR code to add one.
3. Open a device to adjust its color, color temperature, and brightness, and save your favorite presets.
4. Keep the device online before using timers and schedules.
5. Do not turn off the light or Bluetooth, or exit the app, during a firmware update.

data.name: Legal_AgreementContent
data.value:
Welcome to ArriLight. Read and understand this agreement before using the app.
1. This app discovers, connects to, and controls compatible lighting devices.
2. Follow applicable laws and regulations, and keep your account and device access permissions secure.
3. Device compatibility, service coverage, and final terms will be completed before product release.
This is sample text for interface design and is not a final legal document.

data.name: Legal_PrivacyContent
data.value:
We value your privacy and the security of your personal information.
1. Bluetooth permission is used only to discover, connect to, and control nearby compatible devices.
2. Camera permission is used only when you choose to scan a code to add a device.
3. Without your authorization, we will not use personal information for purposes unrelated to the app's core functions.
This is sample text for interface design. The final version should be professionally reviewed before release.
